note: Include-only. build.py renders only these URLs, after a live check that each is MERGED and authored by the profile owner. New candidates go to data/review.json and are never rendered until a human adds them here.

items.issue: TensorListScatter computed its resize length as a signed highest_index + 1, so an index of INT32_MAX overflowed before the resize.
items.fix: Reject INT32_MAX with InvalidArgument and compute the length as size_t, matching the sibling IntoExistingList op.

items.issue: The GPU Dilation kernels counted elements in 32-bit signed ints, so tensors past INT32_MAX elements overflowed, tripped a CHECK, or launched too few threads.
items.fix: Promote counts and loop indices to int64 and launch through GetGpuLaunchConfig64, as gather_nd already does.

items.issue: An automated import in 2020 dropped the EuclideanNorm registration from tf2xla, so reduce_euclidean_norm failed to compile under jit_compile.
items.fix: Restore the PreprocessInput hook on XlaReductionOp and register EuclideanNorm as square, sum, sqrt.

items.issue: tf2xla registered BesselI0e and BesselI1e but not BesselI0 and BesselI1, so bessel_i0 and bessel_i1 aborted XLA compilation.
items.fix: Register both from existing primitives: I0(x) = I0e(x) * exp(|x|), and the same for I1.

items.issue: Grappler fused MatMul or Conv2D with a broadcast bias like [1, N], but the Eigen and GPU kernels demanded a 1-D bias, so the fused op failed inside tf.function.
items.fix: Accept any bias whose leading dimensions are all 1, matching the remapper and the MKL kernel.

items.issue: XLA RangeOp under jit_compile had no path for half, bfloat16, or integer dtypes, so those ranges failed at compile time.
items.fix: Wire the missing dtype handlers so Range works under XLA for those types.

items.issue: A convolution with an invalid rank aborted the Python process instead of returning an error.
items.fix: Raise ValueError so callers can catch the bad shape and keep the process alive.

items.issue: LookupTableExport skipped the dtype signature check its sibling ops run, so a key or value dtype mismatch hit a CHECK and killed the process.
items.fix: Call MatchSignature before exporting, so a mismatch returns InvalidArgumentError.

items.issue: Positional reads and writes on pseudo-terminals returned EINVAL in gVisor, where Linux returns ESPIPE.
items.fix: Set DenyPRead and DenyPWrite on both devpts file descriptions so pread and pwrite return ESPIPE.

items.issue: Value-mapping range inputs rejected minus signs, so you could not set a negative lower or upper bound.
items.fix: Accept signed numbers in the range fields so negative bounds type normally.

proof.anchor: should allow editing negative bounds on existing range mapping
proof.label: should allow editing negative bounds on existing range mapping

items.issue: delta_kt_prime halved the difference when only one neighbor was valid.
items.fix: Use the single valid neighbor difference as is.

items.issue: The CDP pipeline read its BigQuery schema from a relative path at import time, which failed on Dataflow workers.
items.fix: Load the schema through a runtime option and type the coupon join.

items.issue: Regex escape handling swallowed malformed input, and the error suite never ran because the files were named *Tests.java instead of *Test.java.
items.fix: Fail on bad escapes, and rename the suite so Surefire actually executes it.

items.issue: One unreadable remote file or failed local write aborted the whole pull batch.
items.fix: Handle failures per file, finish the remaining batches, and exit 1 on an incomplete pull.

proof.anchor: read and write failures do not stop the same or subsequent batches
proof.label: per-file failure tests

items.issue: Missing, nonpositive, or nonfinite pane sizes could reach PTY creation as invalid geometry.
items.fix: Route creation, resizing, and the attach plan through one helper that clamps to positive integers.

items.issue: Malformed input or a setup failure crashed exec.js before it emitted its JSON result.
items.fix: Validate inputs and route parse and config errors through the existing result emitter.

proof.anchor: invalid JSON and missing or invalid fields produce one JSON error
proof.label: JSON error tests

items.issue: Concurrent writes in one process shared a temp path, causing overwrites and rename failures.
items.fix: Give each write its own temp file and clean it up on failure.

proof.anchor: concurrent writes to one record all finish
proof.label: 100 concurrent writes test

items.issue: Under the daemon, inherited credentials skipped the resolver, so config changes needed a restart.
items.fix: Always run the resolver under the daemon.

proof.anchor: the daemon pre-flight demotes inherited env
proof.label: daemon pre-flight check
